description: Pixel art background: the empty stage set of a late-night TV home shopping channel, seen straight from the front at standing eye height, slightly from above, nobody on stage. A long glossy red and black display counter runs across the lower part of the image and continues past both the left and right edges; one small round product turntable stands on it, left of center. Behind the counter, a lavish red and black lacquer studio set with gold trim, an arch of round marquee bulbs, a big wall screen and spotlights on a truss, all switched off and dark. Pack the whole image with detail everywhere: walls, counter, corners and ceiling all full of set dressing, decoration and texture, a rich, glamorous, slightly eerie TV studio with real depth. Everything else is up to you. Rich lighting with clear shadows. Dense, highly detailed pixel art, crisp pixel clusters, selective dark outline, rich shading, no dithering, no blur. No people, no hands, no chairs, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.
